_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "session_generation" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "server_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "refresh_tokens" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "family_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revoked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("revoked" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "avatar_emoji" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '👤', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pills" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "dosage" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, "current_stock" INTEGER NULL, "low_stock_threshold" INTEGER NULL, "is_prn" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_prn" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "schedules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pills (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "hour" INTEGER NOT NULL, "minute" INTEGER NOT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NULL, "time_zone_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'legacy_unknown', "frequency_days" TEXT NULL, "every_days" INTEGER NULL, "anchor_date" TEXT NULL, "start_date" TEXT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dose_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "schedule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schedules (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "scheduled_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "taken_at" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "sync_status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', "last_sync_at" INTEGER NULL, "is_deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_deleted" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medication_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "server_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "pill_id" TEXT NULL, "schedule_id" TEXT NULL, "occurrence_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("source" IN ('scheduled', 'prn', 'legacy')), "schedule_revision" INTEGER NULL, "planned_local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_local_time" TEXT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "planned_at" INTEGER NULL, "expected" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("expected" = 0 OR "source" IS NOT 'prn') CHECK ("expected" IN (0, 1)), "snapshot_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("snapshot_version" > 0), "schedule_snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("provenance" IN ('exact', 'legacy_estimated')), "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK("state" IN ('pending', 'taken', 'skipped', 'missed')), "state_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("state_version" >= 0), "server_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "superseded_at" INTEGER NULL, "superseded_by_occurrence_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("user_id", "occurrence_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "occurrence_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "occurrence_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES medication_occurrences (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "command_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("action" IN ('take', 'skip', 'undo', 'correct', 'miss')), "from_state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("from_state" IN ('pending', 'taken', 'skipped', 'missed')), "to_state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("to_state" IN ('pending', 'taken', 'skipped', 'missed')), "reverses_event_id" TEXT NULL, "rebases_command_id" TEXT NULL, "actual_at" INTEGER NULL, "actual_time_known" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("actual_time_known" = 0 OR "actual_at" IS NOT NULL) CHECK ("actual_time_known" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "administration_amount_json" TEXT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("origin" IN ('native', 'legacy_backfill', 'legacy_handoff')), "base_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("base_version" >= 0), "result_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("result_version" > "base_version"), "server_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("user_id", "command_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "pill_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "command_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('opening', 'dose', 'dose_reversal', 'refill', 'correction')), "delta" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("delta" IS NOT 0 OR "kind" = 'opening'), "occurrence_event_id" TEXT NULL, "reverses_inventory_event_id" TEXT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("origin" IN ('native', 'legacy_backfill', 'legacy_handoff')), "provenance_json" TEXT NULL, "server_sequence" INTEGER NULL, "recorded_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_operations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "mutation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "component" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("component" IN ('account', 'stable', 'medicationBridge', 'medication')), "operation_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "contract_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("contract_version" IN (1, 2)), "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "depends_on_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK("state" IN ('queued', 'sending', 'conflict', 'failedRetryable', 'blocked', 'committed', 'discarded')), "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("attempt_count" >= 0), "last_attempt_at" INTEGER NULL, "safe_error_code" TEXT NULL, "safe_correlation_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("user_id", "mutation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_operation_effects" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pending_operations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("ordinal" >= 0), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('dose', 'inventory')), "legacy_source_id" TEXT NULL, "request_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued' CHECK("state" IN ('queued', 'sending', 'acknowledged', 'uncertain')), "safe_server_id" TEXT NULL, "safe_result_fingerprint" TEXT NULL, "attempted_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK("attempted_at" IS NOT NULL OR "state" = 'queued'), "acknowledged_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK("acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL OR "state" IS NOT 'acknowledged'), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("operation_id", "ordinal"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_component_states" ("user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "component" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("component" IN ('account', 'stable', 'medicationBridge', 'medication')), "contract_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("contract_version" IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)), "last_completed_cursor" TEXT NULL, "last_full_success_at" INTEGER NULL, "current_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle' CHECK("current_state" IN ('idle', 'running', 'partial', 'failed')), "diagnostic_metadata_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "component"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_staging_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "component" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("component" IN ('account', 'stable', 'medicationBridge', 'medication')), "contract_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("contract_version" IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)), "after_sequence" TEXT NOT NULL, "through_sequence" TEXT NOT NULL, "next_cursor" TEXT NULL, "page_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("page_count" >= 0), "final_page_received" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("final_page_received" IN (0, 1)), "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_staging_items" ("run_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sync_staging_runs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "server_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("run_id", "server_sequence"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "migration_issues" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "issue_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_id" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("revision" > 0), "resolution_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unresolved' CHECK("resolution_state" IN ('unresolved', 'resolved')), "resolved_by_user_id" TEXT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL CHECK("resolved_at" IS NULL AND "resolution_state" = 'unresolved' OR "resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "resolution_state" = 'resolved'), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_workspaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES users (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("kind" IN ('local', 'connected')), "singleton_key" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "binding_state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("binding_state" IN ('local', 'unresolved', 'bound')), "endpoint" TEXT NULL, "legacy_endpoint_hint" TEXT NULL, "current_author_id" TEXT NULL, "selected_profile_id" TEXT NULL, "view_everyone" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("view_everyone" IN (0, 1)), "legacy_viewer_migrated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("legacy_viewer_migrated" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspace_authors" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "display_name" TEXT NULL, "provenance" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("provenance" IN ('workspace', 'imported')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspace_grants" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK("epoch" >= 1), "is_granted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_granted" IN (0, 1)), "session_generation" INTEGER NULL, "network_epoch" INTEGER NULL, "endpoint" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workspace_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_person_reminders" ("profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credential_slots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "endpoint" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("state" IN ('staged', 'published', 'discarded')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "installation_key_slots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "endpoint" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("state" IN ('staged', 'published', 'discarded')), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspace_device_states" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("id" = 'device'), "selected_workspace_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "network_epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("network_epoch" >= 0), "network_owner_id" TEXT NULL, "network_endpoint" TEXT NULL, "network_generation" INTEGER NULL, "network_credential_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES credential_slots (id), "configured_endpoint" TEXT NULL, "installation_epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK("installation_epoch" >= 0), "installation_key_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES installation_key_slots (id), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workspace_sync_checkpoints" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "channel" TEXT NOT NULL, "cursor" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workspace_id", "profile_id", "channel"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "medication_details" ("pill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pills (id), "package_strength" TEXT NULL, "form" TEXT NULL, "amount_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "legacy_dosage_reviewed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("legacy_dosage_reviewed" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("pill_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "setup_drafts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "author_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL, "step" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id), "medication_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES pills (id), "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_routines" ("routine_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "author_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "pill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pills (id), "effective_from_millis" INTEGER NOT NULL, "definition_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("routine_id", "revision"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "care_event_details" ("event_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES occurrence_events (id), "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "command_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspace_authors (id), "author_name" TEXT NULL, "amount_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "command_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_reversal_event_id" TEXT NULL, "stock_outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "stock_effect_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("event_id"), UNIQUE ("workspace_id", "command_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reviewed_stock_balances" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "pill_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pills (id), "author_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workspace_authors (id), "quantity_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "review_revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workspace_id", "pill_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_reminder_settings" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "full_details" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("full_details" IN (0, 1)), "readiness_epoch" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "test_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("workspace_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_schedule_reminders" ("workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "schedule_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES schedules (id), "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "follow_up_minutes_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("workspace_id", "schedule_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_receipts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "source_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_document_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("mode" IN ('selected', 'full')), "selected_profile_ids_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "identity_map_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "applied_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_evidence" ("receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_receipts (id), "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("version" IN ('incoming', 'current')), "ordinal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("ordinal" >= 0), "source_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_base64" TEXT NOT NULL, "disposition" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("disposition" IN ('imported', 'identical', 'conflict', 'quarantined', 'detachedHistory')), PRIMARY KEY ("receipt_id", "entity_table", "entity_key", "version", "ordinal"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "import_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_receipts (id), "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "entity_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "current_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "incoming_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "device_restore_intents" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "receipt_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES import_receipts (id), "expected_preferences_digest" TEXT NOT NULL, "operations_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_operations_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "recovery_generation" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK("state" IN ('pending', 'conflict', 'completed')), "projections_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("projections_completed" IN (0, 1)), "retired_projections_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "effect_settlements" ("effect_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pending_operation_effects (id), "workspace_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES care_workspaces (id), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "issue_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolution_command_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolution" TEXT NOT NULL, "disposition" TEXT NOT NULL, "request_fingerprint" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("effect_id"), UNIQUE ("workspace_id", "issue_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "person_first_seen" ("profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES profiles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "first_seen_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"));
CREATE INDEX medication_occurrences_user_planned_at ON medication_occurrences (user_id, planned_at)
CREATE INDEX occurrence_events_user_occurrence_recorded ON occurrence_events (user_id, occurrence_id, recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX inventory_events_user_pill_recorded ON inventory_events (user_id, pill_id, recorded_at)
CREATE INDEX pending_operations_user_state_created ON pending_operations (user_id, state, created_at)
CREATE INDEX sync_staging_runs_user_component ON sync_staging_runs (user_id, component)
CREATE INDEX migration_issues_user_state_created ON migration_issues (user_id, resolution_state, created_at)
